workspaceTrust.description: Graphics Workbench executes external tools such as Draw.io, rsvg-convert, and Mermaid CLI, so it is not available in untrusted workspaces.
config.execPath.drawio: Command or path for the draw.io executable.
config.execPath.mermaid: Path to the mmdc executable from @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli. If not specified, mmdc will be used.
config.execPath.rsvgConvert: Path to the rsvg-convert executable. If not specified, rsvg-convert will be used.
config.execPath.chrome: Path to the Chrome executable used for Mermaid rendering and Chrome-based SVG to PDF conversion. If not specified, the standard OS command or location is used.
config.raster.maxInputPixels: Maximum number of pixels allowed for a raster image input. Increase this value only when processing very large images, as larger images may require significantly more memory.
config.raster.maxAnimationPixels: Maximum total pixels allowed when retaining or splitting all frames of an animated raster image.
config.preview.maxCanvasPixels: Maximum total pixels for a PDF preview canvas. The preview is downscaled when necessary; output files are unaffected.
config.preview.maxDevicePixelRatio: Maximum device pixel ratio used for PDF previews.
config.performance.maxConcurrentHeavyPro: Maximum number of heavy external rendering processes that may run at the same time. Higher values may increase CPU and memory usage.
config.undoHistory.maxRecords: Maximum number of recent conversions that can be undone in the current session. Older conversion backups are removed when this limit is exceeded.
config.externalTools.drawio.timeoutSecon: Maximum Draw.io execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
config.externalTools.rsvgConvert.timeout: Maximum rsvg-convert execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
config.externalTools.mermaid.timeoutSeco: Maximum Mermaid execution time in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout.
config.convertToPdf.svg.engine: Engine used when converting SVG files to PDF (Chrome or rsvg-convert).
config.convertToWebp.effort: CPU effort used when encoding WebP output. 0 is fastest and 6 is slowest.
config.convertToAvif.effort: CPU effort used when encoding AVIF output. 0 is fastest and 9 is slowest.
config.outputPath.cropPdf: Output file name after cropping the PDF
config.outputPath.clipboardImage: Default output path shown when pasting a clipboard image. The file extension is added automatically.
config.cropPdf.marginOptions: Margin options in PDF points shown when automatically cropping PDFs
config.contextMenu.cropPdf.enabled: Enable context menu for cropping PDFs
config.contextMenu.splitPdf.enabled: Enable context menu for splitting PDFs
config.contextMenu.mergePdf.enabled: Enable context menu for merging PDFs
config.conversion.single.enabled: Show single conversions (1 input → 1 output) in the context menu
config.conversion.split.enabled: Show split conversions (1 input → multiple outputs) in the context menu
config.conversion.combine.enabled: Show combine conversions (multiple inputs → 1 output) in the context menu
command.convertDrawioToPagePdfs: Convert Draw.io pages to separate PDFs

pasteAsImageDetail: Save clipboard image as an image file and insert a figure snippet
pasteOutputPathPrompt: Edit the output path. The file extension is added automatically.
pasteOutputPathOutsideWorkspace: The output path must be inside the workspace.
